\r\n      const params = email ? const { filters } = req.body;\r\n\r\n      const applications = await JobApplication.findByJob(jobId);\r\n      const job = await Job.findById(jobId);\r\n\r\n      let filtered = applications;\r\n\r\n      if (filters && Array.isArray(filters)) {\r\n        filtered = applications.filter(app => {\r\n          const personalInfo = app.personalInfo || {};\r\n          const addressInfo = app.addressInfo || {};\r\n          const positionDetails = app.positionDetails || {};\r\n          const education = app.education || {};\r\n          const employmentHistory = app.employmentHistory || [];\r\n          const skills = app.skills || {};\r\n\r\n          return filters.every(filter => {\r\n            const { field, operator, value } = filter;\r\n\r\n            switch (field) {\r\n              case 'gender':\r\n                if (operator === 'equals') return personalInfo.gender === value;\r\n                if (operator === 'not_equals') return personalInfo.gender !== value;\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'nationality':\r\n                if (operator === 'equals') return personalInfo.nationality === value;\r\n                if (operator === 'not_equals') return personalInfo.nationality !== value;\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'age':\r\n                const dob = personalInfo.dateOfBirth ? new Date(personalInfo.dateOfBirth) : null;\r\n                if (!dob) return false;\r\n                const age = Math.floor((new Date() - dob) / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));\r\n                if (operator === 'gte') return age >= value;\r\n                if (operator === 'lte') return age <= value;\r\n                if (operator === 'equals') return age === value;\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'location':\r\n                const city = addressInfo.residentialAddress?.city || '';\r\n                if (operator === 'equals') return city.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase();\r\n                if (operator === 'contains') return city.toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase());\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'willingToRelocate':\r\n                return positionDetails.willingToRelocate === value;\r\n\r\n              case 'willingToTravel':\r\n                return positionDetails.willingToTravel === value;\r\n\r\n              case 'expectedSalary':\r\n                const salary = parseFloat(positionDetails.expectedSalary) || 0;\r\n                const filterSalary = parseFloat(value) || 0;\r\n                if (operator === 'lte') return salary <= filterSalary;\r\n                if (operator === 'gte') return salary >= filterSalary;\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'qualification':\r\n                const qualifications = education.furtherEducation || [];\r\n                const hasQualification = qualifications.some(edu => \r\n                  edu.qualification?.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase()\r\n                );\r\n                return hasQualification;\r\n\r\n              case 'yearsExperience':\r\n                const totalYears = employmentHistory.reduce((sum, work) => {\r\n                  if (work.startDate && work.endDate) {\r\n                    const start = new Date(work.startDate);\r\n                    const end = new Date(work.endDate);\r\n                    return sum + (end.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear());\r\n                  }\r\n                  return sum;\r\n                }, 0);\r\n                if (operator === 'gte') return totalYears >= value;\r\n                if (operator === 'lte') return totalYears <= value;\r\n                return false;\r\n\r\n              case 'hasCertifications':\r\n                const certs = education.certifications || [];\r\n                return certs.length > 0;\r\n\r\n              case 'language':\r\n                const languages = skills.languages || [];\r\n                return languages.some(lang => \r\n                  lang.language?.toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase())\r\n                );\r\n\r\n              default:\r\n                return true;\r\n            }\r\n          });\r\n        });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      res.json(filtered);\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Failed to filter applicants', error: err.message });\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  async scoreApplicants(req, res) {\r\n    try {\r\n      const job = await Job.findById(req.params.id);\r\n      if (!job) return res.status(404).json({ msg: 'Job not found' });\r\n\r\n      const applications = await JobApplication.findByJob(req.params.id);\r\n      const jobRequirements = job.requirements || '';\r\n      const jobSkills = job.skills || [];\r\n      const jobLocation = job.location || '';\r\n      const jobEducation = job.education || '';\r\n      const jobExperience = job.experience || 0;\r\n\r\n      const scored = applications.map(app => {\r\n        const appData = app.applicationData || {};\r\n        const workHistory = appData.workHistory || [];\r\n        const education = appData.education || [];\r\n        const coverLetter = app.coverLetter || '';\r\n        const appSkills = app.skills || [];\r\n        const appLocation = app.addressInfo?.residentialAddress?.city || '';\r\n        const positionDetails = app.positionDetails || {};\r\n\r\n        // Skills matching (0-100)\r\n        let skillsScore = 0;\r\n        if (jobSkills.length > 0) {\r\n          const matchedSkills = jobSkills.filter(skill => \r\n            appSkills.some(appSkill => \r\n              appSkill.toLowerCase().includes(skill.toLowerCase())\r\n            )\r\n          );\r\n          skillsScore = (matchedSkills.length / jobSkills.length) * 100;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Experience matching (0-100)\r\n        let experienceScore = 0;\r\n        const totalYears = workHistory.reduce((sum, w) => {\r\n          if (w.startDate && w.endDate) {\r\n            const start = new Date(w.startDate);\r\n            const end = new Date(w.endDate);\r\n            return sum + (end.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear());\r\n          }\r\n          return sum;\r\n        }, 0);\r\n        if (jobExperience > 0) {\r\n          experienceScore = Math.min(100, (totalYears / jobExperience) * 100);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Education matching (0-100)\r\n        let educationScore = 0;\r\n        if (jobEducation) {\r\n          const hasRequiredEducation = education.some(edu => \r\n            edu.qualification?.toLowerCase().includes(jobEducation.toLowerCase())\r\n          );\r\n          educationScore = hasRequiredEducation ? 100 : 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Location matching (0-100)\r\n        let locationScore = 0;\r\n        if (jobLocation && appLocation) {\r\n          locationScore = appLocation.toLowerCase().includes(jobLocation.toLowerCase()) ? 100 : 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Final score = average of all criteria\r\n        const finalScore = (skillsScore + experienceScore + educationScore + locationScore) / 4;\r\n\r\n        const rankingBreakdown = {\r\n          skills: { score: skillsScore, matched: jobSkills.filter(skill => \r\n            appSkills.some(appSkill => appSkill.toLowerCase().includes(skill.toLowerCase()))\r\n          ), total: jobSkills.length },\r\n          experience: { score: experienceScore, years: totalYears, required: jobExperience },\r\n          education: { score: educationScore, matched: education.some(edu => \r\n            edu.qualification?.toLowerCase().includes(jobEducation.toLowerCase())\r\n          ), required: jobEducation },\r\n          location: { score: locationScore, applicantLocation: appLocation, required: jobLocation }\r\n        };\r\n\r\n        return {\r\n          applicationId: app.id,\r\n          applicantName: app.applicantName,\r\n          applicantEmail: app.applicantEmail,\r\n          matchScore: Math.round(finalScore),\r\n          rankingBreakdown\r\n        };\r\n      });\r\n\r\n      scored.sort((a, b) => b.matchScore - a.matchScore);\r\n\r\n      // Save scores to DB\r\n      for (const scoredApp of scored) {\r\n        await query(\r\n          `UPDATE job_applications \r\n           SET match_score = $1, ranking_breakdown = $2 \r\n           WHERE id = $3`,\r\n          [scoredApp.matchScore, JSON.stringify(scoredApp.rankingBreakdown), scoredApp.applicationId]\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      res.json(scored);\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Scoring failed', error: err.message });\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  async reallocateRating(req, res) {\r\n    try {\r\n      const { applicationId, newScore, reason } = req.body;\r\n      \r\n      if (!applicationId || newScore === undefined) {\r\n        return res.status(400).json({ msg: 'applicationId and newScore are required' });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (newScore < 0 || newScore > 100) {\r\n        return res.status(400).json({ msg: 'newScore must be between 0 and 100' });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      // Update the score\r\n      await query(\r\n        `UPDATE job_applications \r\n         SET match_score = $1, \r\n             ranking_breakdown = jsonb_set(\r\n               COALESCE(ranking_breakdown, '{}'::jsonb),\r\n               '{manual_override}',\r\n               $2::jsonb\r\n             )\r\n         WHERE id = $3`,\r\n        [newScore, JSON.stringify({ score: newScore, reason, overriddenBy: req.user.id, overriddenAt: new Date() }), applicationId]\r\n      );\r\n\r\n      res.json({ success: true, newScore });\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Failed to reallocate rating', error: err.message });\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  async reverseRating(req, res) {\r\n    try {\r\n      const { applicationId } = req.params;\r\n      \r\n      // Remove manual override and recalculate\r\n      const { rows } = await query(\r\n        `SELECT ranking_breakdown FROM job_applications WHERE id = $1`,\r\n        [applicationId]\r\n      );\r\n\r\n      if (!rows[0]) {\r\n        return res.status(404).json({ msg: 'Application not found' });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const breakdown = rows[0].ranking_breakdown;\r\n      if (breakdown && breakdown.manual_override) {\r\n        delete breakdown.manual_override;\r\n        \r\n        await query(\r\n          `UPDATE job_applications \r\n           SET ranking_breakdown = $1 \r\n           WHERE id = $2`,\r\n          [JSON.stringify(breakdown), applicationId]\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      res.json({ success: true });\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Failed to reverse rating', error: err.message });\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  async importApplicationToEmployee(req, res) {\r\n    try {\r\n      const { appId, employeeId } = req.params;\r\n\r\n      const application = await JobApplication.findById(appId);\r\n      if (!application) {\r\n        return res.status(404).json({ msg: 'Application not found' });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const employee = await Employee.findById(employeeId);\r\n      if (!employee) {\r\n        return res.status(404).json({ msg: 'Employee not found' });\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      // Map application data to employee fields\r\n      const updateData = {};\r\n\r\n      if (application.personalInfo) {\r\n        updateData.dateOfBirth = application.personalInfo.dateOfBirth;\r\n        updateData.gender = application.personalInfo.gender;\r\n        updateData.maritalStatus = application.personalInfo.maritalStatus;\r\n        updateData.nationality = application.personalInfo.nationality;\r\n        updateData.nationalId = application.personalInfo.nationalId;\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (application.addressInfo) {\r\n        updateData.residentialAddress = application.addressInfo.residentialAddress;\r\n        updateData.emergencyContact = application.addressInfo.emergencyContact;\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (application.education) {\r\n        updateData.educationHistory = application.education;\r\n        updateData.certifications = application.education.certifications || [];\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (application.employmentHistory) {\r\n        updateData.employmentHistory = })\r\n      toast.success('Offer sent successfully')\r\n      setShowOfferModal(false)\r\n      setOfferAmount('')\r\n      fetchApplications()\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error('Failed to send }\r\n\r\n  const handleApplyFilters = async () => {\r\n    if (activeFilters.length === 0) {\r\n      fetchApplications()\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await The README incorrectly states MERN stack.\n\n**Core Tables:**\n- `users` - Authentication (id, username, email, password, role, status, reset_token)\n- `employees` - Employee records (id, user_id, status, names, phone, biometric_device_id, wage_rate, department, employment_type)\n- `attendance` - Attendance records (id, employee_id, attendance_date, check_in, check_out, punch_state, status)\n- `payroll` - Payroll records (id, employee_id, period, gross_pay, net_pay, status)\n- `kpi` - Performance tracking (id, employee_id, definition_title, target_value, achieved_value)\n- `leaves` - Leave requests (id, employee_id, type, start_date, end_date, status)\n- `daily_labourers` - Daily labourer profiles (id, user_id, skill_set, daily_rate, status)\n- `settings` - Flexible settings system (id, setting_key, category, setting_value, data_type, validation_rules)\n\n**Relationships:**\n- `employees.user_id` → `users.id` (one-to-one)\n- `attendance.employee_id` → `employees.id` (many-to-one)\n- `daily_labourers.user_id` → `users.id` (one-to-one)\n\n### Backend Structure\n\n```\nbackend/\n├── config/db.js           - PostgreSQL connection pool\n├── middleware/\n│   ├── auth.js            - JWT verification (x-auth-token header)\n│   └── roleMiddleware.js  - Role-based access control\n├── models/\n│   ├── User.model.js      - User CRUD\n│   ├── Employee.model.js  - Employee CRUD\n│   ├── Attendance.model.js - Attendance CRUD\n│   └── [other models]\n├── controllers/\n│   ├── auth.controller.js - Login, register, forgot/reset password\n│   ├── employee.controller.js - Input validation helpers\n│   └── email.js           - Email sending\n└── server.js              - Entry point\n```\n\n### Frontend Structure\n\n```\nfrontend/src/\n├── components/\n│   ├── common/            - Settings cache\n├── pages/\n│   ├── auth/              - Login, Register, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword\n│   ├── admin/             - Admin portal pages\n│   ├── manager/           - Manager portal pages\n│   ├── employee/          - Employee portal pages\n│   ├── dailyLabour/       - Daily labourer pages\n│   └── shared/            - Shared pages (Attendance, etc.)\n├── services/api.js        - Axios instance with auth header\n└── App.jsx                - Routing setup\n```\n\n## Logging Architecture\n\nLogging must be built in from day one — not added later. Use structured console logging (no extra npm packages required).\n\n### Backend: `backend/utils/logger.js`\nCentral logger with timestamped, levelled output. All controllers import this instead of calling `console` directly.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = {\n  info:  (tag, msg, ctx = {}) => console.log( `[${new Date().toISOString()}] INFO  [${tag}] ${msg}`, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n  warn:  (tag, msg, ctx = {}) => console.warn(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] WARN  [${tag}] ${msg}`, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n  error: (tag, msg, err, ctx = {}) => console.error(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] ERROR [${tag}] ${msg}`, err?.stack || err, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n};\nmodule.exports = logger;\n```\n\n### Backend: `backend/middleware/requestLogger.js`\nMount at the **top** of `app.js` before any routes. Logs every request + response status + duration + authenticated user.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = require('../utils/logger');\nmodule.exports = (req, res, next) => {\n  const start = Date.now();\n  const user = req.user ? `${req.user.role}:${req.user.id}` : 'anon';\n  res.on('finish', () => {\n    logger.info('REQUEST', `${req.method} ${req.originalUrl} ${res.statusCode} (${Date.now()-start}ms) user=${user}`);\n  });\n  next();\n};\n```\n\n### Backend: Per-Controller Pattern\nEvery controller function must follow this pattern:\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = require('../utils/logger');\n\nconst myFunction = async (req, res) => {\n  logger.info('myController.myFunction', 'Entry', { userId: req.user?.id, params: req.params, body: req.body });\n  try {\n    // ... logic\n    const { normalized, errors } = validatePayload(req.body);\n    if (errors.length) {\n      logger.warn('myController.myFunction', 'Validation failed', { errors });\n      return res.status(400).json({ msg: 'Validation failed', errors });\n    }\n    // ... DB call\n    logger.info('myController.myFunction', 'Success', { resultCount: rows.length });\n    res.json(rows);\n  } catch (err) {\n    logger.error('myController.myFunction', 'Unhandled error', err, { userId: req.user?.id });\n    res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Server error' });\n  }\n};\n```\n\n**What to log at each level:**\n\n| Level | When |\n|---|---|\n| INFO | Function entry with key params, successful DB results (row count only) |\n| WARN | Validation errors, 404 not-found, unauthorised access attempts |\n| ERROR | All `catch` blocks with full stack trace |\n\n### Frontend: `frontend/src/utils/logger.js`\nBrowser-side structured logger with coloured groups.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = {\n  info:  (tag, msg, ctx) => console.log( `%c[INFO]  [${tag}]`, 'color:#3b82f6', msg, ctx || ''),\n  warn:  (tag, msg, ctx) => console.warn(`%c[WARN]  [${tag}]`, 'color:#f59e0b', msg, ctx || ''),\n  error: (tag, msg, err, ctx) => console.error(`%c[ERROR] [${tag}]`, 'color:#ef4444', msg, err, ctx || ''),\n};\nexport default logger;\n```\n\n### Frontend: Axios Interceptors in `api.js`\nAdd logging to the request and response interceptors:\n\n```javascript\n// Request interceptor — log outgoing\napi.interceptors.request.use(config => {\n  logger.info('api', `→ ${config.method?.toUpperCase()} ${config.url}`);\n  config.metadata = { startTime: Date.now() };\n  return config;\n});\n\n// Response interceptor — log success and errors\napi.interceptors.response.use(\n  response => {\n    const ms = Date.now() - response.config.metadata?.startTime;\n    logger.info('api', `← ${response.status} ${response.config.url} (${ms}ms)`);\n    return response;\n  },\n  error => {\n    const ms = Date.now() - error.config?.metadata?.startTime;\n    logger.error('api', `← ${error.response?.status} ${error.config?.url} (${ms}ms)`,\n      null,\n      { data: error.response?.data, body: error.config?.data }\n    );\n    return Promise.reject(error);\n  }\n);\n```\n\n### Frontend: Global Error Handlers in `main.jsx`\n```javascript\nwindow.onerror = (msg, src, line, col, err) =>\n  logger.error('window.onerror', msg, err, { src, line, col });\n\nwindow.onunhandledrejection = (e) =>\n  logger.error('window.onunhandledrejection', 'Unhandled promise rejection', e.reason);\n```\n\n### Frontend: ErrorBoundary Enhancement\nIn `componentDidCatch`, call `logger.error('ErrorBoundary', error.message, error, { componentStack: info.componentStack })`.\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Build Instructions\n\n### Phase 1: Database Setup\n\n1. **Create PostgreSQL database** (local or cloud)\n2. **Run `init-database.sql`** to create all tables\n3. **Run `seed-data.sql`** to populate initial data (users, roles)\n4. **Verify tables exist** using PostgreSQL client\n\n**Critical:** Do NOT use MongoDB. The entire backend uses `pg` (PostgreSQL driver) with raw SQL queries, not Mongoose ODM.\n\n### Phase 2: Backend Setup\n\n1. **Initialize Node.js project:**\n   ```bash\n   cd backend\n   npm init -y\n   npm install express pg cors dotenv jsonwebtoken bcryptjs multer nodemailer pdfkit node-cron\n   ```\n\n2. **Create `.env` file:**\n   ```\n   DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/ubuntu-hrms\n   JWT_SECRET=your-secret-key-min-32-chars\n   FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5173\n   EMAIL_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\n   EMAIL_PORT=587\n   EMAIL_USER=your-email@gmail.com\n   EMAIL_PASS=your-app-password\n   ```\n\n3. **Build core files in order:**\n   - `config/db.js` - PostgreSQL connection pool\n   - `utils/logger.js` - **Build this first** — all other files depend on it\n   - `middleware/auth.js` - JWT verification\n   - `middleware/requestLogger.js` - Request logging middleware\n   - `models/User.model.js` - User model with password hashing\n   - `controllers/auth.controller.js` - Login, register, password reset\n   - `routes/auth.routes.js` - Auth endpoints\n   - `server.js` - Express app setup\n\n4. **Implement each module:**\n   - Employees (model, controller, routes)\n   - Attendance (model, controller, routes)\n   - Payroll (model, controller, routes)\n   - KPI, Leaves, Contracts, etc.\n\n5. **Register routes in `app.js`:**\n   ```javascript\n   // Mount requestLogger FIRST — before all routes\n   app.use(require('./middleware/requestLogger'));\n\n   app.use('/api/auth', require('./routes/auth.routes'));\n   app.use('/api/employees', require('./routes/employee.routes'));\n   // ... other routes\n   ```\n\n### Phase 3: Frontend Setup\n\n1. **Initialize React project:**\n   ```bash\n   cd frontend\n   npm create vite@latest . -- --template react\n   npm install react-router-dom axios react-toastify tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer\n   npm install lucide-react recharts @radix-ui/react-select clsx tailwind-merge\n   ```\n\n2. **Configure Tailwind CSS:**\n   - Initialize: `npx tailwindcss init -p`\n   - Configure `tailwind.config.js` with content paths\n   - Add directives to `index.css`\n\n3. **Build core files in order:**\n   - `src/utils/logger.js` - **Build this first** — browser-side logger\n   - `src/services/api.js` - Axios instance with x-auth-token header + logging interceptors\n   - `src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx` - Auth state management + login/logout logging\n   - `src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.jsx` - Error boundary with `logger.error` in `componentDidCatch`\n   - `src/components/common/` - Base components (Button, Card, Input, Table, Modal)\n   - `src/components/DashboardLayout.jsx` - Main layout wrapper\n   - `src/components/Sidebar.jsx` - Navigation\n   - `src/pages/auth/Login.jsx` - Login page\n   - `src/App.jsx` - Routing setup\n\n4. **Implement pages by role:**\n   - Admin: Dashboard, Employees, Attendance, Payroll, KPI, Leaves, Reports\n   - Manager: Dashboard, Team Attendance, Leave Approvals\n   - Employee: Dashboard, My Attendance, My Leaves, Profile\n   - Daily Labourer: Dashboard (attendance/payments summary)\n\n5. **Implement protected routes:**\n   - Create `ProtectedRoute` component\n   - Check token existence and role\n   - Redirect to `/login` if unauthorized\n\n### Phase 4: Integration Testing\n\n1. **Test authentication flow:**\n   - Register a user\n   - Login and verify token stored\n   - Access protected route\n   - Logout and verify token cleared\n\n2. **Test CRUD operations:**\n   - Create employee\n   - Read employee list\n   - Update employee\n   - Delete employee\n\n3. **Test attendance:**\n   - Record check-in\n   - Record check-out\n   - Verify hours calculated\n\n4. **Test payroll:**\n   - Calculate payroll for period\n   - Verify amounts match attendance\n\n## Critical Implementation Details\n\n### Authentication\n\n**Backend:**\n- JWT secret must be at least 32 characters\n- Token expires in 1 hour\n- Passwords hashed with bcryptjs (10 rounds)\n- Reset tokens expire in 1 hour\n- Auth middleware checks `x-auth-token` header\n\n**Frontend:**\n- Token stored in `localStorage` as `authToken`\n- Axios interceptor adds `x-auth-token` to all requests\n- AuthContext decodes token to get user info\n- Protected routes check role before rendering\n\n### Route Order (Express)\n\n**CRITICAL:** Specific routes must come before parameterized routes:\n```javascript\n// CORRECT\nrouter.get('/me', ctrl.getMe);\nrouter.get('/by-user/:userId', ctrl.getByUserId);\nrouter.get('/:id', ctrl.getById);\n\n// WRONG - /:id will match /me first\nrouter.get('/:id', ctrl.getById);\nrouter.get('/me', ctrl.getMe);\n```\n\n### User-Employee Linkage\n\nEmployees are linked to users via `employees.user_id → users.id`. When fetching employee data for the logged-in user:\n- Get `user.id` from JWT (`req.user.id`)\n- Query `employees WHERE user_id = $1`\n- For daily labourers, use `daily_labourers WHERE user_id = $1`\n\n### Validation\n\nBackend uses `utils/validation.js`:\n- `validateEmployeePayload()` - Validates employee data\n- `validateAttendancePayload()` - Validates attendance data\n- Returns `{ normalized, errors }` object\n- Errors array contains specific validation messages\n\nFrontend should display `errors.join(', ')` for inline validation feedback.\n\n### Settings System\n\nFlexible settings stored in `settings` table:\n- `setting_key` + `category` unique constraint\n- `setting_value` stored as TEXT (JSON for complex data)\n- `validation_rules` JSONB for client-side validation\n- Settings cached in `SettingsContext` on frontend\n\n### Attendance States\n\nPunch states: `checkIn`, `breakOut`, `breakIn`, `checkOut`\n- `checkIn` sets `attendance.check_in` and status to 'Present'\n- `checkOut` sets `attendance.check_out`\n- `breakOut`/`breakIn` track break times\n- `totalHoursWorked` recalculated after each punch\n\n## Known Issues & Limitations\n\n### 1. Route Matching Conflicts\n**Issue:** Express parameterized routes (`/:id`) intercept specific routes (`/me`)\n**Fix:** Always place specific routes before parameterized routes in route files\n**Example:** `router.get('/me', ...)` must come before `router.get('/:id', ...)`\n\n### 2. Daily Labourer Dashboard 404\n**Issue:** `/api/daily-labourers/me` returns 404 due to route conflict\n**Fix:** Use `/api/daily-labourers/by-user/:userId` instead (named segment never conflicts)\n\n### 3. Validation Errors Not Displayed Inline\n**Issue:** Backend returns `{ msg: 'Validation failed', errors: [...] }` but frontend only shows generic message\n**Fix:** Parse `error.response.data.errors` array and display joined messages inline\n\n### 4. Frontend Caching After Backend Changes\n**Issue:** Vite HMR may not reflect backend route changes\n**Fix:** Restart backend server after adding new routes\n\n### 5. Database Schema Mismatches\n**Issue:** Models expect columns that don't exist in database\n**Fix:** Always run `init-database.sql` before starting; check model `mapRow` functions match actual columns\n\n### 6. Missing User-Employee Linkage\n**Issue:** Employee records not linked to user accounts\n**Fix:** Run `link-daily-labourer-user.js` script to link users to employee records via `user_id`\n\n### 7. Role-Based Access Not Enforced\n**Issue:** Frontend routes protected but backend routes lack role middleware\n**Fix:** Add `roleMiddleware(['admin', 'manager'])` to sensitive routes\n\n### 8. PostgreSQL vs MongoDB Confusion\n**Issue:** README states MERN stack but code uses PostgreSQL\n**Fix:** Use PostgreSQL with `pg` driver; do NOT use Mongoose\n\n### 9. Email Service Not Configured\n**Issue:** Password reset requires email but SMTP not set up\n**Fix:** Configure EMAIL_HOST, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_PASS in `.env`\n\n### 10. Biometric Device Integration\n**Issue:** Biometric device push endpoint needs public URL\n**Fix:** Deploy backend to public URL (Render, Heroku) and register webhook with device\n\n## Common Pitfalls to Avoid\n\n1. **Do NOT use MongoDB** - The entire backend uses PostgreSQL with raw SQL\n2. **Do NOT use Mongoose** - Models are plain JavaScript classes with SQL queries\n3. **Do NOT place `/:id` before `/me`** - Route order matters in Express\n4. **Do NOT forget to restart backend** - New routes won't load without restart\n5. **Do NOT hardcode JWT_SECRET** - Use environment variable\n6. **Do NOT store passwords in plain text** - Always hash with bcryptjs\n7. **Do NOT skip database initialization** - Run `init-database.sql` first\n8. **Do NOT ignore validation errors array** - Parse and display inline\n9. **Do NOT use `module.exports` with individual `exports`** - Causes conflicts\n10. **Do NOT forget CORS configuration** - Frontend won't reach backend without it\n\n## Deployment Checklist\n\n### Backend\n- [ ] Set production DATABASE_URL\n- [ ] Set strong JWT_SECRET\n- [ ] Configure email service (SMTP)\n- [ ] Set FRONTEND_URL to production URL\n- [ ] Enable HTTPS\n- [ ] Configure CORS for production origin\n- [ ] Register biometric device webhook URL\n- [ ] Set up M-Pesa Daraja production credentials\n\n### Frontend\n- [ ] Set VITE_API_URL to production backend URL\n- [ ] Build with `npm run build`\n- [ ] Deploy `dist/` folder to static host\n- [ ] Verify API calls work in production\n- [ ] Test authentication flow end-to-end\n\n## Default Credentials\n\n| Role | Username | Password |\n|------|----------|----------|\n| Admin | admin | password123 |\n| Manager | manager | password123 |\n| Employee | employee | password123 |\n| Daily Labourer | daily_labourer | password123 |\n\n## File Reference Summary\n\n**Key Backend Files:**\n- `server.js` - When fetching employee data for the logged-in user:\n- Get `user.id` from JWT (`req.user.id`)\n- Query `employees WHERE user_id = $1`\n- For daily labourers, use `daily_labourers WHERE user_id = $1`\n\n### Validation\n\nBackend uses `utils/validation.js`:\n- `validateEmployeePayload()` - Validates employee data\n- `validateAttendancePayload()` - Validates attendance data\n- Returns `{ normalized, errors }` object\n- Errors array contains specific validation messages\n\nFrontend should display `errors.join(', ')` for inline validation feedback.\n\n### Settings System\n\nFlexible settings stored in `settings` table:\n- `setting_key` + `category` unique constraint\n- `setting_value` stored as TEXT (JSON for complex data)\n- `validation_rules` JSONB for client-side validation\n- Settings cached in `SettingsContext` on frontend\n\n### Attendance States\n\nPunch states: `checkIn`, `breakOut`, `breakIn`, `checkOut`\n- `checkIn` sets `attendance.check_in` and status to 'Present'\n- `checkOut` sets `attendance.check_out`\n- `breakOut`/`breakIn` track break times\n- `totalHoursWorked` recalculated after each punch\n\n## Known Issues & Limitations\n\n### 1. Route Matching Conflicts\n**Issue:** Express parameterized routes (`/:id`) intercept specific routes (`/me`)\n**Fix:** Always place specific routes before parameterized routes in route files\n**Example:** `router.get('/me', ...)` must come before `router.get('/:id', ...)`\n\n### 2. Daily Labourer Dashboard 404\n**Issue:** `/api/daily-labourers/me` returns 404 due to route conflict\n**Fix:** Use `/api/daily-labourers/by-user/:userId` instead (named segment never conflicts)\n\n### 3. Validation Errors Not Displayed Inline\n**Issue:** Backend returns `{ msg: 'Validation failed', errors: [...] }` but frontend only shows generic message\n**Fix:** Parse `error.response.data.errors` array and display joined messages inline\n\n### 4. Frontend Caching After Backend Changes\n**Issue:** Vite HMR may not reflect backend route changes\n**Fix:** Restart backend server after adding new routes\n\n### 5. Database Schema Mismatches\n**Issue:** Models expect columns that don't exist in database\n**Fix:** Always run `init-database.sql` before starting; check model `mapRow` functions match actual columns\n\n### 6. Missing User-Employee Linkage\n**Issue:** Employee records not linked to user accounts\n**Fix:** Run `link-daily-labourer-user.js` script to link users to employee records via `user_id`\n\n### 7. Role-Based Access Not Enforced\n**Issue:** Frontend routes protected but backend routes lack role middleware\n**Fix:** Add `roleMiddleware(['admin', 'manager'])` to sensitive routes\n\n### 8. PostgreSQL vs MongoDB Confusion\n**Issue:** README states MERN stack but code uses PostgreSQL\n**Fix:** Use PostgreSQL with `pg` driver; do NOT use Mongoose\n\n### 9. Email Service Not Configured\n**Issue:** Password reset requires email but SMTP not set up\n**Fix:** Configure EMAIL_HOST, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_PASS in `.env`\n\n### 10. Biometric Device Integration\n**Issue:** Biometric device push endpoint needs public URL\n**Fix:** Deploy backend to public URL (Render, Heroku) and register webhook with device\n\n## Common Pitfalls to Avoid\n\n1. **Do NOT use MongoDB** - The entire backend uses PostgreSQL with raw SQL\n2. **Do NOT use Mongoose** - Models are plain JavaScript classes with SQL queries\n3. **Do NOT place `/:id` before `/me`** - Route order matters in Express\n4. **Do NOT forget to restart backend** - New routes won't load without restart\n5. **Do NOT hardcode JWT_SECRET** - Use environment variable\n6. **Do NOT store passwords in plain text** - Always hash with bcryptjs\n7. **Do NOT skip database initialization** - Run `init-database.sql` first\n8. **Do NOT ignore validation errors array** - Parse and display inline\n9. **Do NOT use `module.exports` with individual `exports`** - Causes conflicts\n10. **Do NOT forget CORS configuration** - Frontend won't reach backend without it\n\n## Deployment Checklist\n\n### Backend\n- [ ] Set production DATABASE_URL\n- [ ] Set strong JWT_SECRET\n- [ ] Configure email service (SMTP)\n- [ ] Set FRONTEND_URL to production URL\n- [ ] Enable HTTPS\n- [ ] Configure CORS for production origin\n- [ ] Register biometric device webhook URL\n- [ ] Set up M-Pesa Daraja production credentials\n\n### Frontend\n- [ ] Set VITE_API_URL to production backend URL\n- [ ] Build with `npm run build`\n- [ ] Deploy `dist/` folder to static host\n- [ ] Verify API calls work in production\n- [ ] Test authentication flow end-to-end\n\n## Default Credentials\n\n| Role | Username | Password |\n|------|----------|----------|\n| Admin | admin | password123 |\n| Manager | manager | password123 |\n| Employee | employee | password123 |\n| Daily Labourer | daily_labourer | password123 |\n\n## File Reference Summary\n\n**Key Backend Files:**\n- `server.js` - Use structured console logging (no extra npm packages required).\n\n### Backend: `backend/utils/logger.js`\nCentral logger with timestamped, levelled output. All controllers import this instead of calling `console` directly.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = {\n  info:  (tag, msg, ctx = {}) => console.log( `[${new Date().toISOString()}] INFO  [${tag}] ${msg}`, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n  warn:  (tag, msg, ctx = {}) => console.warn(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] WARN  [${tag}] ${msg}`, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n  error: (tag, msg, err, ctx = {}) => console.error(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] ERROR [${tag}] ${msg}`, err?.stack || err, Object.keys(ctx).length ? ctx : ''),\n};\nmodule.exports = logger;\n```\n\n### Backend: `backend/middleware/requestLogger.js`\nMount at the **top** of `app.js` before any routes. Logs every request + response status + duration + authenticated user.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = require('../utils/logger');\nmodule.exports = (req, res, next) => {\n  const start = Date.now();\n  const user = req.user ? `${req.user.role}:${req.user.id}` : 'anon';\n  res.on('finish', () => {\n    logger.info('REQUEST', `${req.method} ${req.originalUrl} ${res.statusCode} (${Date.now()-start}ms) user=${user}`);\n  });\n  next();\n};\n```\n\n### Backend: Per-Controller Pattern\nEvery controller function must follow this pattern:\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = require('../utils/logger');\n\nconst myFunction = async (req, res) => {\n  logger.info('myController.myFunction', 'Entry', { userId: req.user?.id, params: req.params, body: req.body });\n  try {\n    // ... logic\n    const { normalized, errors } = validatePayload(req.body);\n    if (errors.length) {\n      logger.warn('myController.myFunction', 'Validation failed', { errors });\n      return res.status(400).json({ msg: 'Validation failed', errors });\n    }\n    // ... DB call\n    logger.info('myController.myFunction', 'Success', { resultCount: rows.length });\n    res.json(rows);\n  } catch (err) {\n    logger.error('myController.myFunction', 'Unhandled error', err, { userId: req.user?.id });\n    res.status(500).json({ msg: 'Server error' });\n  }\n};\n```\n\n**What to log at each level:**\n\n| Level | When |\n|---|---|\n| INFO | Function entry with key params, successful DB results (row count only) |\n| WARN | Validation errors, 404 not-found, unauthorised access attempts |\n| ERROR | All `catch` blocks with full stack trace |\n\n### Frontend: `frontend/src/utils/logger.js`\nBrowser-side structured logger with coloured groups.\n\n```javascript\nconst logger = {\n  info:  (tag, msg, ctx) => console.log( `%c[INFO]  [${tag}]`, 'color:#3b82f6', msg, ctx || ''),\n  warn:  (tag, msg, ctx) => console.warn(`%c[WARN]  [${tag}]`, 'color:#f59e0b', msg, ctx || ''),\n  error: (tag, msg, err, ctx) => console.error(`%c[ERROR] [${tag}]`, 'color:#ef4444', msg, err, ctx || ''),\n};\nexport default logger;\n```\n\n### Frontend: Axios Interceptors in `api.js`\nAdd logging to the request and response interceptors:\n\n```javascript\n// Request interceptor — log outgoing\napi.interceptors.request.use(config => {\n  logger.info('api', `→ ${config.method?.toUpperCase()} ${config.url}`);\n  config.metadata = { startTime: Date.now() };\n  return config;\n});\n\n// Response interceptor — log success and errors\napi.interceptors.response.use(\n  response => {\n    const ms = Date.now() - response.config.metadata?.startTime;\n    logger.info('api', `← ${response.status} ${response.config.url} (${ms}ms)`);\n    return response;\n  },\n  error => {\n    const ms = Date.now() - error.config?.metadata?.startTime;\n    logger.error('api', `← ${error.response?.status} ${error.config?.url} (${ms}ms)`,\n      null,\n      { data: error.response?.data, body: error.config?.data }\n    );\n    return Promise.reject(error);\n  }\n);\n```\n\n### Frontend: Global Error Handlers in `main.jsx`\n```javascript\nwindow.onerror = (msg, src, line, col, err) =>\n  logger.error('window.onerror', msg, err, { src, line, col });\n\nwindow.onunhandledrejection = (e) =>\n  logger.error('window.onunhandledrejection', 'Unhandled promise rejection', e.reason);\n```\n\n### Frontend: ErrorBoundary Enhancement\nIn `componentDidCatch`, call `logger.error('ErrorBoundary', error.message, error, { componentStack: info.componentStack })`.\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step Build Instructions\n\n### Phase 1: Database Setup\n\n1. **Create PostgreSQL database** (local or cloud)\n2. **Run `init-database.sql`** to create all tables\n3. **Run `seed-data.sql`** to populate initial data (users, roles)\n4. **Verify tables exist** using PostgreSQL client\n\n**Critical:** Do NOT use MongoDB. The entire backend uses `pg` (PostgreSQL driver) with raw SQL queries, not Mongoose ODM.\n\n### Phase 2: Backend Setup\n\n1. **Initialize Node.js project:**\n   ```bash\n   cd backend\n   npm init -y\n   npm install express pg cors dotenv jsonwebtoken bcryptjs multer nodemailer pdfkit node-cron\n   ```\n\n2. **Create `.env` file:**\n   ```\n   DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/ubuntu-hrms\n   JWT_SECRET=your-secret-key-min-32-chars\n   FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5173\n   EMAIL_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\n   EMAIL_PORT=587\n   EMAIL_USER=your-email@gmail.com\n   EMAIL_PASS=your-app-password\n   ```\n\n3. **Build core files in order:**\n   - `config/db.js` - PostgreSQL connection pool\n   - `utils/logger.js` - **Build this first** — all other files depend on it\n   - `middleware/auth.js` - JWT verification\n   - `middleware/requestLogger.js` - Request logging middleware\n   - `models/User.model.js` - User model with password hashing\n   - `controllers/auth.controller.js` - Login, register, password reset\n   - `routes/auth.routes.js` - Auth endpoints\n   - `server.js` - Express app setup\n\n4. **Implement each module:**\n   - Employees (model, controller, routes)\n   - Attendance (model, controller, routes)\n   - Payroll (model, controller, routes)\n   - KPI, Leaves, Contracts, etc.\n\n5. **Register routes in `app.js`:**\n   ```javascript\n   // Mount requestLogger FIRST — before all routes\n   app.use(require('./middleware/requestLogger'));\n\n   app.use('/api/auth', require('./routes/auth.routes'));\n   app.use('/api/employees', require('./routes/employee.routes'));\n   // ... other routes\n   ```\n\n### Phase 3: Frontend Setup\n\n1. **Initialize React project:**\n   ```bash\n   cd frontend\n   npm create vite@latest . -- --template react\n   npm install react-router-dom axios react-toastify tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer\n   npm install lucide-react recharts @radix-ui/react-select clsx tailwind-merge\n   ```\n\n2. **Configure Tailwind CSS:**\n   - Initialize: `npx tailwindcss init -p`\n   - Configure `tailwind.config.js` with content paths\n   - Add directives to `index.css`\n\n3. **Build core files in order:**\n   - `src/utils/logger.js` - **Build this first** — browser-side logger\n   - `src/services/api.js` - Axios instance with x-auth-token header + logging interceptors\n   - `src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx` - Auth state management + login/logout logging\n   - `src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.jsx` - Error boundary with `logger.error` in `componentDidCatch`\n   - `src/components/common/` - Base components (Button, Card, Input, Table, Modal)\n   - `src/components/DashboardLayout.jsx` - Main layout wrapper\n   - `src/components/Sidebar.jsx` - Navigation\n   - `src/pages/auth/Login.jsx` - Login page\n   - `src/App.jsx` - Routing setup\n\n4. **Implement pages by role:**\n   - Admin: Dashboard, Employees, Attendance, Payroll, KPI, Leaves, Reports\n   - Manager: Dashboard, Team Attendance, Leave Approvals\n   - Employee: Dashboard, My Attendance, My Leaves, Profile\n   - Daily Labourer: Dashboard (attendance/payments summary)\n\n5. **Implement protected routes:**\n   - Create `ProtectedRoute` component\n   - Check token existence and role\n   - Redirect to `/login` if unauthorized\n\n### Phase 4: Integration Testing\n\n1. **Test authentication flow:**\n   - Register a user\n   - Login and verify token stored\n   - Access protected route\n   - Logout and verify token cleared\n\n2. **Test CRUD operations:**\n   - Create employee\n   - Read employee list\n   - Update employee\n   - Delete employee\n\n3. **Test attendance:**\n   - Record check-in\n   - Record check-out\n   - Verify hours calculated\n\n4. **Test payroll:**\n   - Calculate payroll for period\n   - Verify amounts match attendance\n\n## Critical Implementation Details\n\n### Authentication\n\n**Backend:**\n- JWT secret must be at least 32 characters\n- Token expires in 1 hour\n- Passwords hashed with bcryptjs (10 rounds)\n- Reset tokens expire in 1 hour\n- Auth middleware checks `x-auth-token` header\n\n**Frontend:**\n- Token stored in `localStorage` as `authToken`\n- Axios interceptor adds `x-auth-token` to all requests\n- AuthContext decodes token to get user info\n- Protected routes check role before rendering\n\n### Route Order (Express)\n\n**CRITICAL:** Specific routes must come before parameterized routes:\n```javascript\n// CORRECT\nrouter.get('/me', ctrl.getMe);\nrouter.get('/by-user/:userId', ctrl.getByUserId);\nrouter.get('/:id', ctrl.getById);\n\n// WRONG - /:id will match /me first\nrouter.get('/:id', ctrl.getById);\nrouter.get('/me', ctrl.getMe);\n```\n\n### User-Employee Linkage\n\nEmployees are linked to users via `employees.user_id → users.id`. When fetching employee data for the logged-in user:\n- Get `user.id` from JWT (`req.user.id`)\n- Query `employees WHERE user_id = $1`\n- For daily labourers, use `daily_labourers WHERE user_id = $1`\n\n### Validation\n\nBackend uses `utils/validation.js`:\n- `validateEmployeePayload()` - Validates employee data\n- `validateAttendancePayload()` - Validates attendance data\n- Returns `{ normalized, errors }` object\n- Errors array contains specific validation messages\n\nFrontend should display `errors.join(', ')` for inline validation feedback.\n\n### Settings System\n\nFlexible settings stored in `settings` table:\n- `setting_key` + `category` unique constraint\n- `setting_value` stored as TEXT (JSON for complex data)\n- `validation_rules` JSONB for client-side validation\n- Settings cached in `SettingsContext` on frontend\n\n### Attendance States\n\nPunch states: `checkIn`, `breakOut`, `breakIn`, `checkOut`\n- `checkIn` sets `attendance.check_in` and status to 'Present'\n- `checkOut` sets `attendance.check_out`\n- `breakOut`/`breakIn` track break times\n- `totalHoursWorked` recalculated after each punch\n\n## Known Issues & Limitations\n\n### 1. Route Matching Conflicts\n**Issue:** Express parameterized routes (`/:id`) intercept specific routes (`/me`)\n**Fix:** Always place specific routes before parameterized routes in route files\n**Example:** `router.get('/me', ...)` must come before `router.get('/:id', ...)`\n\n### 2. Daily Labourer Dashboard 404\n**Issue:** `/api/daily-labourers/me` returns 404 due to route conflict\n**Fix:** Use `/api/daily-labourers/by-user/:userId` instead (named segment never conflicts)\n\n### 3. Validation Errors Not Displayed Inline\n**Issue:** Backend returns `{ msg: 'Validation failed', errors: [...] }` but frontend only shows generic message\n**Fix:** Parse `error.response.data.errors` array and display joined messages inline\n\n### 4. Frontend Caching After Backend Changes\n**Issue:** Vite HMR may not reflect backend route changes\n**Fix:** Restart backend server after adding new routes\n\n### 5. Database Schema Mismatches\n**Issue:** Models expect columns that don't exist in database\n**Fix:** Always run `init-database.sql` before starting; check model `mapRow` functions match actual columns\n\n### 6. Missing User-Employee Linkage\n**Issue:** Employee records not linked to user accounts\n**Fix:** Run `link-daily-labourer-user.js` script to link users to employee records via `user_id`\n\n### 7. Role-Based Access Not Enforced\n**Issue:** Frontend routes protected but backend routes lack role middleware\n**Fix:** Add `roleMiddleware(['admin', 'manager'])` to sensitive routes\n\n### 8. PostgreSQL vs MongoDB Confusion\n**Issue:** README states MERN stack but code uses PostgreSQL\n**Fix:** Use PostgreSQL with `pg` driver; do NOT use Mongoose\n\n### 9. Email Service Not Configured\n**Issue:** Password reset requires email but SMTP not set up\n**Fix:** Configure EMAIL_HOST, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_PASS in `.env`\n\n### 10. Biometric Device Integration\n**Issue:** Biometric device push endpoint needs public URL\n**Fix:** Deploy backend to public URL (Render, Heroku) and register webhook with device\n\n## Common Pitfalls to Avoid\n\n1. **Do NOT use MongoDB** - The entire backend uses PostgreSQL with raw SQL\n2. **Do NOT use Mongoose** - Models are plain JavaScript classes with SQL queries\n3. **Do NOT place `/:id` before `/me`** - Route order matters in Express\n4. **Do NOT forget to restart backend** - New routes won't load without restart\n5. **Do NOT hardcode JWT_SECRET** - Use environment variable\n6. **Do NOT store passwords in plain text** - Always hash with bcryptjs\n7. **Do NOT skip database initialization** - Run `init-database.sql` first\n8. **Do NOT ignore validation errors array** - Parse and display inline\n9. **Do NOT use `module.exports` with individual `exports`** - Causes conflicts\n10. **Do NOT forget CORS configuration** - Frontend won't reach backend without it\n\n## Deployment Checklist\n\n### Backend\n- [ ] Set production DATABASE_URL\n- [ ] Set strong JWT_SECRET\n- [ ] Configure email service (SMTP)\n- [ ] Set FRONTEND_URL to production URL\n- [ ] Enable HTTPS\n- [ ] Configure CORS for production origin\n- [ ] Register biometric device webhook URL\n- [ ] Set up M-Pesa Daraja production credentials\n\n### Frontend\n- [ ] Set VITE_API_URL to production backend URL\n- [ ] Build with `npm run build`\n- [ ] Deploy `dist/` folder to static host\n- [ ] Verify API calls work in production\n- [ ] Test authentication flow end-to-end\n\n## Default Credentials\n\n| Role | Username | Password |\n|------|----------|----------|\n| Admin | admin | password123 |\n| Manager | manager | password123 |\n| Employee | employee | password123 |\n| Daily Labourer | daily_labourer | password123 |\n\n## File Reference Summary\n\n**Key Backend Files:**\n- `server.js` - Attendance\nconst AttendanceCalendar = ({ attendance, dateJoined }) => {\n  const [hoveredDay, setHoveredDay] = useState(null);\n  \n  // Get last 2 months\n  const today = new Date();\n  const currentMonth = today.getMonth();\n  const currentYear = today.getFullYear();\n  \n  const prevMonth = currentMonth === 0 ? 11 : currentMonth - 1;\n  const prevYear = currentMonth === 0 ? currentYear - isBeforeEmployment\n      });\n    }\n    \n    return days;\n  };\n  \n  const getStatusColor = (record, isFuture, isBeforeEmployment) => {\n    if (isFuture || isBeforeEmployment) return case 'late':\n        return 'bg-amber-400';\n      case 'absent':\n        return 'bg-slate-300';\n      case 'leave':\n        return 'bg-rose-400';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-slate-200';\n    <div className=\"text-sm text-slate-600\">Total Days</div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg p-4\">\n          <div className=\"text-2xl font-bold       </div>\n      </div>\n      \n      {/* Calendar Grid */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8\">\n        {renderMonth(prevYear, prevMonth, monthNames[prevMonth])}\n <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n          <div className=\"w-4 h-4 rounded bg-slate-200\" />\n          <span className=\"text-sm text-slate-600\">No Data</span>\n        </div>\n {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    fetchApplications();\r\n  }, [jobId]);\r\n\r\n  const openModal = (app) => {\r\n    setSelected(app);\r\n    setStatus(app.status);\r\n    setRecruiterAnnouncement(app.recruiterAnnouncement || '');\r\n    setShowModal(true);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleStatusUpdate = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      await api.put(`/jobs/applications/${selected.id}/status`, { status, recruiterAnnouncement });\r\n      toast.success('Status updated');\r\n      setShowModal(false);\r\n      fetchApplications();\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error('Update failed');\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleScoreApplicants = async () => {\r\n    setScoring(true)\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await })\r\n      toast.success('Offer sent successfully')\r\n      setShowOfferModal(false)\r\n      setOfferAmount('')\r\n      fetchApplications()\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error('Failed to send }\r\n\r\n  const handleApplyFilters = async () => {\r\n    if (activeFilters.length === 0) {\r\n      fetchApplications()\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await setShowVerificationModal(true);\r\n      } catch (err) {\r\n        toast.error('Failed to load verification results');\r\n      }\r\n    } else {\r\n      handleVerifyApplication(app.id);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleUpdateManagerRanking = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      await verificationAPI.updateManagerRanking(jobId, selected.id, managerRanking, managerNotes);\r\n employeeIds: [], kpi_definition_id: '', period: '', target_value: '' });\r\n\r\n  // Filters\r\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\r\n  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    fetchInitialData();\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  const fetchInitialData = async () => {\r\n    setLoading(true);\r\n    try {\r\n      const [defsRes, empRes, globalRes] = await Promise.allSettled([\r\n        getKPIs(),\r\n        employeeAPI.getAll(),\r\n        api.get('/api/kpis/all').catch(() => ({ data: [] }))\r\n      ]);\r\n\r\n      if (defsRes.status === 'fulfilled') setKpiDefs(defsRes.value.data || []);\r\n      if (empRes.status === 'fulfilled') setEmployees(empRes.value.data || []);\r\n      if (globalRes.status === 'fulfilled') setEmployeeKpis(globalRes.value.data || []);\r\n      \r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      console.error('Failed to load KPI data:', error);\r\n      toast.error('Failed to load KPI data');\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setLoading(false);\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleChange = e => setForm({ ...form, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });\r\n  \r\n  const handleSubmit = async e => {\r\n    e.preventDefault();\r\n    try {\r\n      // Transform the form state to match what the backend expects\r\n      const apiPayload = {\r\n        title: form.name,\r\n        description: form.description,\r\n        maxScore: Number(form.target)\r\n      };\r\n\r\n      if (editing) {\r\n        await updateKPI(editing, apiPayload);\r\n        toast.success('KPI definition updated');\r\n      } else {\r\n        await createKPI(apiPayload);\r\n        toast.success('KPI definition created');\r\n      }\r\n      \r\n      // Reset form\r\n      setForm({ name: '', description: '', target: '' });\r\n      setEditing(null);\r\n      setShowDefModal(false);\r\n      \r\n      // Refresh data\r\n      const res = await getKPIs();\r\n      setKpiDefs(res.data || []);\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      console.error(\"API Error:\", err.response?.data || err.message);\r\n      toast.error(err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save KPI definition');\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleEdit = kpi => { \r\n    setForm({\r\n      name: kpi.title || kpi.name || '',\r\n      description: kpi.description || '',\r\n      target: kpi.maxScore || kpi.max_score || kpi.target || ''\r\n    }); \r\n    setEditing(kpi._id || kpi.id); \r\n    setShowDefModal(true);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleDelete = async id => { \r\n    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this KPI definition?')) return;\r\n    try {\r\n      await deleteKPI(id); \r\n      toast.success('KPI deleted');\r\n      const res = await getKPIs();\r\n      setKpiDefs(res.data || []);\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      toast.error('Failed to delete KPI');\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const getEmployeeName = (empId) => {\r\n    if (!empId) return 'Unassigned';\r\n    const emp = employees.find(e => String(e.id) === String(empId) || String(e._id) === String(empId));\r\n    return emp ? `${emp.firstName || ''} ${emp.lastName || ''}`.trim() || emp.username || emp.email : empId;\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleAssignSubmit = async e => {\r\n    e.preventDefault();\r\n    try {\r\n      const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');\r\n      const evaluatorId = currentUser.id || currentUser._id || assignForm.employee_id;\r\n\r\n      await api.post('/api/kpis/assign', { \r\n        employeeId: assignForm.employee_id,\r\n        definitionId: assignForm.kpi_definition_id,\r\n        evaluatorId: evaluatorId,\r\n        period: assignForm.period,\r\n        targetValue: Number(assignForm.target_value)\r\n      });\r\n      toast.success('KPI assigned successfully');\r\n      setShowAssignModal(false);\r\n      setAssignForm({ employee_id: '', kpi_definition_id: '', period: '', target_value: '' });\r\n      fetchInitialData();\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      toast.error(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.msg || 'Failed to assign KPI');\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleBulkAssign = async (e) => {\r\n    e.preventDefault();\r\n    try {\r\n      const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');\r\n      const evaluatorId = currentUser.id || currentUser._id;\r\n      const def = kpiDefs.find(d => String(d.id || d._id) === String(bulkForm.kpi_definition_id));\r\n\r\n      await api.post('/api/kpis/bulk-assign', {\r\n        employeeIds: bulkForm.employeeIds,\r\n        definitionId: bulkForm.kpi_definition_id,\r\n        evaluatorId,\r\n        period: bulkForm.period,\r\n        targetValue: Number(bulkForm.target_value || def?.target || def?.maxScore || def?.max_score || 100)\r\n      });\r\n      toast.success(`KPI assigned to ${bulkForm.employeeIds.length} employees`);\r\n      setShowBulkModal(false);\r\n      setBulkForm({ employeeIds: [], kpi_definition_id: '', period: '', target_value: '' });\r\n      fetchInitialData();\r\n    } catch (err) {\r\n      toast.error(err.response?.data?.error || 'Bulk assign failed');\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const filteredEmployeeKpis = useMemo(() => {\r\n    return employeeKpis.filter(kpi => {\r\n      const empId = kpi.employee_id || kpi.employeeId || kpi.employee || kpi.user_id;\r\n      const empName = String(getEmployeeName(empId)).toLowerCase();\r\n      const kpiTitle = String(kpi.definition_title || kpi.title || '').toLowerCase();\r\n      const search = searchQuery.toLowerCase();\r\n      \r\n      const matchesSearch = !search || empName.includes(search) || kpiTitle.includes(search);\r\n      const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || (kpi.status || 'Pending') === statusFilter;\r\n      \r\n      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;\r\n    });\r\n  }, [employeeKpis, searchQuery, statusFilter, employees]);\r\n\r\n  const handleExportGlobalReport = async () => {\r\n    await downloadPdfReport({\r\n      fileName: 'company-kpi-report.pdf',\r\n      title: 'Company Global KPI Performance Report',\r\n      rows: filteredEmployeeKpis,\r\n      columns: [\r\n        { label: 'Employee', getValue: (row) => getEmployeeName(row.employee_id || row.employeeId || row.employee || row.user_id) },\r\n        { label: 'KPI Title', getValue: (row) => row.definition_title || row.title || 'N/A' },\r\n        { label: 'Period', getValue: (row) => row.period || '' },\r\n        { label: 'Target', getValue: (row) => String(row.target_value || '') },\r\n        { label: 'Achieved', getValue: (row) => String(row.achieved_value || '0') },\r\n        { label: 'Score (%)', getValue: (row) => String(row.final_score || '0') },\r\n        { label: 'Status', getValue: (row) => row.status || 'Pending' }\r\n      ],\r\n      metadata: [\r\n        { label: 'Status Filter', value: statusFilter === 'all' ? 'All' : statusFilter },\r\n        { label: 'Total Records', value: String(filteredEmployeeKpis.length) }\r\n      ],\r\n    });\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const defColumns = [\r\n    { key: 'name', label: 'KPI Name / Title', render: (_, row) => row.name || row.title },\r\n    { key: 'description', label: 'Description' },\r\n    { key: 'target', label: 'Target Metric', render: (_, row) => row.target || row.maxScore || row.max_score },\r\n    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (_, row) => (\r\n        <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\r\n          <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"secondary\" onClick={() => handleEdit(row)}>Edit</Button>\r\n          <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"danger\" onClick={() => handleDelete(row._id || row.id)}>Delete</Button>\r\n        </div>\r\n    )}\r\n  ];\r\n\r\n  const globalKpiColumns = [\r\n    {\r\n      key: 'employee',\r\n      label: 'Employee',\r\n      render: (_, row) => {\r\n        const empId = row.employee_id || row.employeeId || row.employee || row.user_id;\r\n        const empName = getEmployeeName(empId);\r\n        return (\r\n          <button\r\n            onClick={() => navigate(`/admin/employees/${empId}`)}\r\n            className=\"text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-700 hover:underline font-medium cursor-pointer\"\r\n          >\r\n            {empName}\r\n          </button>\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      key: 'title',\r\n      label: 'Goal Title',\r\n      render: (_, row) => {\r\n        const title = row.definition_title || row.title || 'N/A';\r\n        return (\r\n          <button\r\n            onClick={() => toast.info(`KPI: ${title}`)}\r\n            className=\"text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 hover:text-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-400 font-medium cursor-pointer\"\r\n          >\r\n            {title}\r\n          </button>\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      key: 'period',\r\n      label: 'Quarter',\r\n      render: (_, row) => {\r\n        const period = row.period;\r\n        return (\r\n          <button\r\n            onClick={() => {\r\n              setSearchQuery(period);\r\n              toast.info(`Filtered by period: ${period}`);\r\n            }}\r\n            className=\"text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer\"\r\n          >\r\n            {period}\r\n          </button>\r\n        );\r\n      }\r\n    },\r\n    { key: 'target_value', label: 'Target', render: (_, row) => row.target_value },\r\n    { key: 'achieved_value', label: 'Achieved', render: (_, row) => row.achieved_value ?? '-' },\r\n    { key: 'score', label: 'Score', render: (_, row) => {\r\n        const score = Number(row.final_score ?? 0);\r\n        return (\r\n           <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-[100px] cursor-pointer\" onClick={() => toast.info(`Score breakdown: ${score}%`)}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1 h-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden\">\r\n                 <div className={`h-full ${score >= 80 ? 'bg-green-500' : score >= 50 ? 'bg-yellow-500' : 'bg-red-500'}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score))}%` }} />\r\n              </div>\r\n              <span className=\"text-xs font-semibold\">{score}%</span>\r\n           </div>\r\n        );\r\n    }},\r\n    {\r\n      key: 'status',\r\n      label: 'Status',\r\n      render: (_, row) => {\r\n        const status = row.status || 'Pending';\r\n        return (\r\n          <button\r\n            onClick={() => {\r\n              setStatusFilter(status);\r\n              toast.info(`Filtered by status: ${status}`);\r\n            }}\r\n            className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity ${status === 'Completed' ? Math.round(evaluatedKpis.reduce((sum, k) => sum + Number(k.final_score), 0) / evaluatedKpis.length) \r\n    : 0;\r\n  const completedCount = employeeKpis.filter(k => k.status === 'Completed').length;\r\n\r\n  const scoreDistribution = {\r\n    excellent: evaluatedKpis.filter(k => Number(k.final_score) >= 85).length,\r\n    average: evaluatedKpis.filter(k => Number(k.final_score) >= 50 && Number(k.final_score) < 85).length,\r\n    poor: evaluatedKpis.filter(k => Number(k.final_score) < 50).length,\r\n  };\r\n  const maxDist = Math.max(...Object.values(scoreDistribution), 1);\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <DashboardLayout>\r\n      <div className=\"page-header mb-6\">\r\n        <h1 className=\"page-title\">Global KPIs & Performance</h1>\r\n        <p className=\"page-subtitle\">Track company-wide goals, manage KPI definitions, and view performance reports.</p>\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      <div className=\"flex space-x-4 mb-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-x-auto\">\r\n        <button\r\n          className={`pb-2 px-1 border-b-2 font-medium text-sm transition-colors ${activeTab === 'all' ?             {kpiDefs.map(def => (\r\n                <option key={def.id || def._id} value={def.id || def._id}>{def.name || def.title}</option>\r\n              ))}\r\n            </select>\r\n          </div>\r\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\r\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300\">Period</label>\r\n            <select         <optgroup label={`${new Date().getFullYear()} Quarters`}>\r\n                {['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'].map(q => (\r\n                  <option key={`${q} ${new Date().getFullYear()}`}       if (!edu.endYear) newErrors[`education.${i}.endYear`] = 'End year is required'\r\n          if (!/^\\d{4}$/.test(edu.endYear)) newErrors[`education.${i}.endYear`] = 'Invalid year format'\r\n          if (parseInt(edu.endYear) < parseInt(edu.startYear)) newErrors[`education.${i}.endYear`] = 'End year must be >= start year'\r\n        })\r\n        setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 3:\r\n        if (form.employmentHistory.length === 0) newErrors.employmentHistory = 'At least one employment entry is required'\r\n newErrors.availabilityWeeks = 'Availability must be between 0 and 52 weeks'\r\n        }\r\n        if (!form.rightToWork) newErrors.rightToWork = 'Right to work is required'\r\n        if case 7:\r\n        if (!form.declarationConfirmed) newErrors.declarationConfirmed = 'You must confirm the declaration'\r\n        if (!form.privacyPolicyConfirmed) newErrors.privacyPolicyConfirmed =     setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      default:\r\n        return false\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const nextStep = () => {\r\n    if (validateStep(currentStep)) {\r\n      setCurrentStep(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, 7))\r\n    } else {\r\n      toast.error('Please fill in all required fields')\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const prevStep = () => setCurrentStep(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))\r\n\r\n  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {\r\n    e.preventDefault()\r\n    // Only allow submission on step 7\r\n    if (currentStep !== 7) {\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n    if (!validateStep(7)) {\r\n      toast.error('Please complete all required fields')\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // Confirm submission\r\n    const confirmed = window.confirm('Are you sure you want to submit your application?')\r\n    if (!confirmed) {\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    setSubmitting(true)\r\n    try {\r\n      const data = new FormData()\r\n\r\n      // Basic info\r\n      data.append('applicantName', `${form.surname} ${form.firstName} ${form.otherNames}`.trim())\r\n      data.append('applicantEmail', form.email)\r\n      data.append('applicantPhone', form.phone)\r\n      data.append('applicationMode', 'structured')\r\n\r\n      // Multi-step form data\r\n      data.append('personal_info', JSON.stringify({\r\n {\r\n        surname: form.surname,\r\n        firstName: form.firstName,\r\n        otherNames: form.otherNames,\r\n        dateOfBirth: form.dateOfBirth,\r\n        gender: form.gender,\r\n        maritalStatus: form.maritalStatus,\r\n        nationality: form.nationality,\r\n        nationalId: form.nationalId,\r\n        phone: form.phone,\r\n        email: form.email,\r\n        address: toast.error(err.response?.data?.msg || 'Application failed')\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setSubmitting(false)\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const resetForm = () => {\r\n    setForm({\r\n      surname: '', salaryExpectation: '',\r\n      declarationConfirmed: false,\r\n      privacyPolicyConfirmed: false,\r\n      signature: '',\r\n    })\r\n    setCurrentStep(1)\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  if (loading) return <DashboardLayout><div className=\"text-center py-8\">Loading...</div></DashboardLayout>\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <DashboardLayout>\r\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto py-8 max-w-4xl\">\r\n        <Card>\r\n          <div className=\"mb-6\">\r\n            <h1 className=\"text-3xl font-bold mb-2\">Apply for Position</h1>\r\n            {job && (\r\n              <div className=\"p-4 </div>\r\n\r\n          {/* Step Indicator */}\r\n          <div className=\"mb-8\">\r\n            <div className=\"relative\">\r\n              {/* Background bar */}\r\n              <div             {STEPS.map((step) => (\r\n                  <div key={step.id} className=\"flex flex-col items-center\" style={{ width: '14.28%' }}>\r\n                    <div className={`w-8 h-8       ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n\r\n          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\r\n            {/* Step 1: Personal Information */}\r\n 'Date of birth is required'\r\n        if (!form.gender) newErrors.gender = 'Gender is required'\r\n        if (!form.maritalStatus) newErrors.maritalStatus = 'Marital status is required'\r\n        if (!form.nationality) newErrors.nationality = 'Nationality is required'\r\n        if (!form.nationalId.trim()) newErrors.nationalId = 'National ID is required'\r\n        if (!form.phone.trim()) (!form.email.trim()) newErrors.email = 'Email is required'\r\n        else if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(form.email)) newErrors.email = 'Invalid email format'\r\n        setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 2:\r\n        if (form.education.length === 0) newErrors.education = 'At least one education entry is (!edu.program.trim()) newErrors[`education.${i}.program`] = 'Program is required'\r\n          if (!edu.educationLevel) newErrors[`education.${i}.educationLevel`] = 'Education level is required'\r\n          if (!edu.startYear) newErrors[`education.${i}.startYear`] = 'Start year is required'\r\n          if (!/^\\d{4}$/.test(edu.startYear)) newErrors[`education.${i}.startYear`] = 'Invalid year  return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 3:\r\n        if (form.employmentHistory.length === 0) newErrors.employmentHistory = 'At least one employment entry is required'\r\n        form.employmentHistory.forEach((work, i) => {\r\n          if (!work.employer.trim()) newErrors[`employmentHistory.${i}.employer`] = 'Employer is required'\r\n          if (!work.jobTitle.trim()) newErrors[`employmentHistory.${i}.jobTitle`] = 'Job title is required'\r\n          if (!work.startDate) newErrors[`employmentHistory.${i}.startDate`] = 'Start date is required'\r\n          if (!work.isCurrentJob && !work.endDate) newErrors[`employmentHistory.${i}.endDate`] = 'End date is required'\r\n          if (work.startDate && work.endDate && new Date(work.endDate) < new Date(work.startDate)) {\r\n            newErrors[`employmentHistory.${i}.endDate`] = 'End date must be >= start date'\r\n          }\r\n        })\r\n        setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 4:\r\n        form.certifications.forEach((cert, i) => {\r\n          if (cert.name && !cert.issuingOrganization) is required'\r\n          if (cert.name && !cert.noExpiry && !cert.expiryDate) newErrors[`certifications.${i}.expiryDate`] = 'Expiry date is required'\r\n          if (cert.issuingDate &&  })\r\n        setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 5:\r\n        if (!form.cv) newErrors.cv = 'CV is required'\r\n        setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      case 6:\r\n        if (!form.experienceYears) newErrors.experienceYears = 'Experience years is required'\r\n        if (form.experienceYears newErrors.availabilityWeeks = 'Availability must be between 0 and 52 weeks'\r\n        }\r\n        if (!form.rightToWork) newErrors.rightToWork = 'Right to work is required'\r\n        if case 7:\r\n        if (!form.declarationConfirmed) newErrors.declarationConfirmed = 'You must confirm the declaration'\r\n        if (!form.privacyPolicyConfirmed) newErrors.privacyPolicyConfirmed =     setErrors(newErrors)\r\n        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0\r\n      default:\r\n        return false\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const nextStep = () => {\r\n    if (validateStep(currentStep)) {\r\n      setCurrentStep(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, 7))\r\n    } else {\r\n      toast.error('Please fill in all required fields')\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const prevStep = () => setCurrentStep(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))\r\n\r\n  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {\r\n    e.preventDefault()\r\n    // Only allow submission on step 7\r\n    if (currentStep !== 7) {\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n    if (!validateStep(7)) {\r\n      toast.error('Please complete all required fields')\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // Confirm submission\r\n    const confirmed = window.confirm('Are you sure you want to submit your application?')\r\n    if (!confirmed) {\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    setSubmitting(true)\r\n    try {\r\n      const data = new FormData()\r\n\r\n      // Basic info\r\n      data.append('applicantName', `${form.surname} ${form.firstName} ${form.otherNames}`.trim())\r\n      data.append('applicantEmail', form.email)\r\n      data.append('applicantPhone', form.phone)\r\n      data.append('applicationMode', 'structured')\r\n\r\n      // Multi-step form data\r\n      data.append('personal_info', JSON.stringify({\r\n        surname: form.surname,\r\n        firstName: form.firstName,\r\n        otherNames: form.otherNames,\r\n        dateOfBirth: form.dateOfBirth,\r\n        gender: form.gender,\r\n        maritalStatus: data.append('education', JSON.stringify({\r\n        education: form.education,\r\n        certifications: form.certifications,\r\n      }))\r\n\r\n      data.append('employment_history', form.salaryExpectation,\r\n      }))\r\n\r\n      if (form.cv) data.append('cv', form.cv)\r\n      if (form.coverLetterFile) data.append('coverLetter', form.coverLetterFile)\r\n\r\n      await api.post(`/jobs/${jobId}/apply`, data, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } })\r\n\r\n      // Save personal information for future applications\r\n      const personalInfoToSave = {\r\n        surname: form.surname,\r\n        firstName: form.firstName,\r\n        otherNames: form.otherNames,\r\n        dateOfBirth: form.dateOfBirth,\r\n        gender: form.gender,\r\n        maritalStatus: form.maritalStatus,\r\n        nationality: form.nationality,\r\n        nationalId: form.nationalId,\r\n        phone: form.phone,\r\n        email: form.email,\r\n        address: toast.error(err.response?.data?.msg || 'Application failed')\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setSubmitting(false)\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const resetForm = () => {\r\n    setForm({\r\n      surname: '', firstName: '', otherNames: '', dateOfBirth: '', gender: '', maritalStatus: '', nationality: '', nationalId: '', phone: '', email: '',\r\n      education: [],\r\n      employmentHistory: [],\r\n      certifications: [],\r\n      cv: null,\r\n      coverLetter: null,\r\n      otherDocuments: [],\r\n      experienceYears: '',\r\n      availabilityWeeks: '',\r\n      rightToWork: '',\r\n      salaryExpectation: '',\r\n      declarationConfirmed: false,\r\n      privacyPolicyConfirmed: false,\r\n      signature: '',\r\n    })\r\n    setCurrentStep(1)\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  if (loading) return <DashboardLayout><div className=\"text-center py-8\">Loading...</div></DashboardLayout>\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <DashboardLayout>\r\n      <div className=\"container mx-auto py-8 max-w-4xl\">\r\n        <Card>\r\n          <div className=\"mb-6\">\r\n            <h1 className=\"text-3xl font-bold mb-2\">Apply for Position</h1>\r\n            {job && (\r\n              <div className=\"p-4 </div>\r\n\r\n          {/* Step Indicator */}\r\n          <div className=\"mb-8\">\r\n            <div className=\"relative\">\r\n              {/* Background bar */}\r\n              <div             {STEPS.map((step) => (\r\n                  <div key={step.id} className=\"flex flex-col items-center\" style={{ width: '14.28%' }}>\r\n                    <div className={`w-8 h-8       ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n\r\n          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\r\n            {/* Step 1: Personal Information */}\r\n
